# Leena by Alekhya

Leena by Alekhya is a women's boutique fashion website at https://leenabyalekhya.in.

## Important URLs

- Home: https://leenabyalekhya.in/
- Shop: https://leenabyalekhya.in/shop
- New arrivals: https://leenabyalekhya.in/shop?filter=new
- Bestsellers: https://leenabyalekhya.in/shop?filter=bestseller
- About: https://leenabyalekhya.in/about
- Contact: https://leenabyalekhya.in/contact

## Business Summary

Leena by Alekhya offers premium women's ethnic wear and boutique fashion, including frocks, A-line dresses, 2-piece sets, 3-piece sets, anarkalis, premium collections, and lehenga sets.
